headline: ASF: private pension funds reach 246.2 billion lei, 39% more than last year
summary: Assets managed by private pension funds in Romania reached 246.2 billion lei at end-June 2026, 39% above a year earlier. The ASF said the figure equals about 12.35% of GDP.
why: Private pension funds are large institutional investors whose asset growth affects domestic equity and bond demand. The Romanian Financial Supervisory Authority (ASF) regulates the sector.
